Chapter 946: Chapter 10: Xia Qin, the Supreme Surprise (Please Subscribe)

“What should we do?”

All the alien races at Level Twelve fell into silence.

If the Galaxy Master were just an ordinary Level Eleven, the ultimates of Level Twelve would have many strategies at their disposal.

But on a super-large battlefield, the Galaxy Master’s power completely overshadows a regular Level Eleven, and he can be considered the strongest Level Eleven since the birth of the universe.

In light of this, dealing with the Galaxy Master is incredibly troublesome.

After all, they are not facing just the Galaxy Master but also a human civilization and nine peerless powerhouses of the same level.

“If the rules involved in the Martial Tao Level Eleven are true, it means the Galaxy Master has reached an inconceivable realm in understanding the rules.”

“Such a life form, once successfully stepping into Level Twelve, will quickly grow to the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm.”

“By then, it won’t be about how we deal with the Galaxy Master anymore, but how the Galaxy Master deals with us.”

The Prison Tribe ultimate slowly spoke up.

Honestly, if their tribal forces could produce a peak Path Splitting Realm powerhouse, their first action would be to sweep through all the major forces in the universe.

However, the peak of the Path Splitting Realm is exceedingly difficult to reach. In dozens or hundreds of universes, there might only be one who can ascend to such a peak.

Although the Robber Clan has two ultimates at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, they are rejected by the will of the universe and dare not exert their full strength, thus they don’t count as normal peak Path Splitting Realm powers.

“Peak of the Path Splitting Realm? Human civilization?”

The expression of the Insect Queen darkened further.

By then, the Insect Race would surely face severe suppression from human civilization. Just the thought of a peak Path Splitting Realm powerhouse wielding a Clan Suppression Weapon is enough to terrify her.

“The Galaxy Master is already a Perfect Level Eleven, and his true body will definitely be protected by human civilization. How should we handle him?”

The Yu Clan ultimate said.

Even if they wanted to deal with the Galaxy Master now, they would have to assess whether they had the capability.

Curse to kill? Level Twelve ultimates personally taking action could indeed curse and kill all avatars and true bodies of Level Nine and Ten powerhouses, but since the Galaxy Master is Level Eleven, even Level Twelve ultimates could not curse him to death, no matter the cost.

“Actually, it’s not like there’s no way.”

The Prison Tribe ultimate suddenly spoke, his gaze turning towards the Insect Queen, “If I remember correctly, when a strange creature fell from outside the universe into it, didn’t the Myriad Transformation Queen take a drop of blood from that strange creature?”

In the early stages of the universe’s formation, a strange creature fell into it, almost causing a mass extinction of life. Only after many Level Twelve ultimates worked together did they manage to barely drive that strange creature out.

This strange creature wasn’t a normal life form, possessing only instinct and no consciousness. Life at Level Twelve from outside couldn’t enter the universe.

The strange creature had a powerful body that attacks at Level Twelve could hardly shake.

But somehow the Myriad Transformation Queen managed to tear the creature’s skin and obtain a drop of blood.

“That strange creature had a terrifying contamination ability, its blood is something even we dare not touch. If we can locate an avatar or an incarnation of the Galaxy Master and contaminate it with the strange blood… even if the Galaxy Master does not die, he will be severely injured, which will then affect his potential to break through to Level Twelve!”

The Prison Tribe ultimate looked towards the Insect Queen.

The rest of the Level Twelve ultimates were slightly shaken upon hearing this.

They were unaware of this, but since the Prison Tribe ultimate was so certain, it must be true.

“Strange blood?”

The Insect Queen frowned, “I need to speak to the Myriad Transformation about this.”

Among the Insect Race’s Queens, the Myriad Transformation Queen was the most powerful and ancient, holding the highest status.

“I hope the Myriad Transformation understands the bigger picture,” the Prison Tribe ultimate nodded and said.

A moment later.

The Insect Queen looked around at the other Level Twelve ultimates, “The Myriad Transformation is willing to take out that drop of blood.”

“That’s very good.” The Prison Tribe ultimate breathed a sigh of relief.

When the strange creature fell into the universe, human civilization had not yet been born, so the supreme beings of human civilization did not know about this.

The Prison Tribe ultimate only knew about the actions of the Myriad Transformation Queen because of his abilities and brought it up today.

“However, that drop of strange blood is the source of endless chaos and contamination. The Myriad Transformation regards it as a treasure. She is willing to take it out, but it’s not without reason.”

The Insect Queen suddenly said.

“Whatever the Myriad Transformation’s demands are, she can state them,” the Prison Tribe ultimate nodded.

“Don’t worry; whatever the Myriad Transformation needs, our clans will surely provide,” the other Level Twelve ultimates assured in succession.

A moment later.

The conditions were agreed upon by the Level Twelve ultimates.

“Next, we just need to lock onto an avatar or incarnation of the Galaxy Master and use all our strength to suppress it, and then apply that drop of strange blood.”

The Insect Queen spoke up.

“Of course,” the other Level Twelve ultimates nodded.

Just then.

The always silent Robber Clan ultimate spoke: “My Robber Clan has no interest in the Galaxy Master of human civilization, we will withdraw from this operation.”

“The Robber Clan is withdrawing?”

The many Level Twelve ultimates were somewhat surprised.

If a Path Splitting Realm ultimate were to emerge within human civilization, the Robber Clan would surely be affected.

Human civilization would not specifically spare the Robber Clan; after all, a peak of the Path Splitting Realm meant invincibility within the universe, and other Level Twelve ultimates could only avoid them.

“No need for further words.”

The Robber Clan ultimate vanished instantly.

“These two old fellows have the realm of the peak of the Path Splitting Realm but such small courage,” the Prison Tribe ultimate frowned deeply.

“However, to deal with a Galaxy Master, our united forces are enough,” the Insect Queen shook her head and said.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan was observing the eighteen dominant bizarre trees, watching how they absorbed Chaos Qi, how they converted the wild and unstable Chaos Qi into the energy they needed.

“Marvelous, marvelous, marvelous!”

Brilliant insights surged in Lin Yuan’s mind as he comprehended the Chaos Rule; his understanding of Chaos Qi was already profound. Now, observing the essence of the eighteen bizarre trees, he vaguely grasped the perfect method for absorbing and inhaling Chaos Qi.

“The most abundant thing in the Chaos Void is Chaos Qi; mastering the method to directly swallow and absorb Chaos Qi would greatly reduce reliance on cultivation resources.”

Even practitioners at the Chaos Realm cannot directly absorb Chaos Qi; they need to purify and refine the primitive Chaos Qi, achieving the level close to that contained within Chaos Stones, to absorb it smoothly.

Those at the Mastery Realm and even at the Path Splitting Realm, who wish to perceive Chaos Qi and thereby understand the Chaos Rule, can only do so via Chaos Stones, as the Chaos Qi within them is stable and the easiest to comprehend.

Directly perceiving the Chaos Rule from primitive Chaos Qi? The difficulty is too high, and it is filled with disorderly and wild energy.

One of Lin Yuan’s avatars, formed from condensed Chaos Qi, was merely one application of Chaos Qi.

And it is a different concept from directly absorbing primitive Chaos Qi.

The essence of absorbing primitive Chaos Qi is about transforming the primitive Chaos Qi into one’s own energy, whereas forming an avatar using primitive Chaos Qi is solely about the avatar.

“Let’s try it on the World Tree.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly, and he looked towards the World Tree within his inner world.

Having comprehended the Chaos Rule, Lin Yuan could now channel some Chaos Qi from beyond the universe to nurture the World Tree.

But that was merely nurturing; even the World Tree of Level Eleven Perfect grade couldn’t absorb Chaos Qi directly. And to infuse it with Chaos Stones? Too extravagant, and Lin Yuan was naturally reluctant to do that.

If the World Tree acquired the capability to directly absorb Chaos Qi, it would probably be highly beneficial for its transformation into the Chaos Tree.

“Hmm?”

“The Supreme Xia Qin is looking for me?”

Lin Yuan’s expression suddenly shifted, and his Taiyang Divine Spirit residing outside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm immediately sent out a spiritual will to connect to the Virtual World.

…

Virtual World.

The Supreme Xia Qin’s personal world.

“I pay my respects to the Supreme Being,” Lin Yuan said with a slight bow, showing his respect.

“Lin Yuan.” A smile appeared on the Supreme Xia Qin’s face, then his expression became slightly solemn, “The fact you are the founder of the Martial Tao evolutionary path can no longer be concealed.”

In fact, Lin Yuan was indeed the founder of the Martial Tao evolutionary path; it had been rumored for hundreds of years but at that time, the rumors were still faint and lacked substantial evidence.

However, with the recent emergence of the First Tier Chapter of Martial Tao, these rumors peaked.

“I am aware,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Through the advancement from the Sixth Layer to the Ninth Layer, Lin Yuan worried that his identity as the founder of Martial Tao would leak, attracting the attention and potential actions of the Level Twelve Ultimate beings from other races.

But now?

Lin Yuan might not be Level Twelve, yet he closely rivals one, and naturally has no fear of them anymore.

“Indeed.”

Supreme Xia Qin smiled and said, “With your strength, even if those beings want to curse or influence you, it would be meaningless.”

After speaking, Supreme Xia Qin pondered for a moment, then continued, “But being prepared for the worst is wise. Given the potential of the Martial Tao evolutionary path, I can guess without even guessing where those beings are hiding and thinking about how to deal with you.”

“What do you suggest, Supreme Being?” Lin Yuan inquired.

“Why not have your true self come to the Central Star Field? That’s the safest place in our human civilization. Even if a dozen or so Level Twelve beings from other races join hands to attack, we can hold them off,” Supreme Xia Qin immediately suggested.

Although the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization are always attentive to the Milky Way Main Star, ready to intervene at any sign of trouble.

Yet the Milky Way Main Star is not at the heart of the human civilization’s territory.

And it is situated at the edge of the domain, something that in Supreme Xia Qin’s opinion, still poses some risks.

“My true self?”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while.

His true self was now in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which was definitely safer than the Central Star Field of Human Civilization.

“Supreme Being, where do you think my true self currently is?” Lin Yuan asked.

“Your true self?” Supreme Xia Qin sensed along the causal connection for a moment, “It’s not at the Milky Way Main Star?”

“Only one of my avatars is on the Milky Way Main Star,” Lin Yuan stated truthfully.

Since Lin Yuan’s real body settled in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the Taiyang Divine Spirit and Taiyin Primordial Spirit had been taking turns to reside on the Milky Way Main Star.

“Just an avatar on the Milky Way Main Star?” Supreme Xia Qin’s expression shifted slightly.

“My true self is currently in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm,” Lin Yuan said frankly, without any concealment.

At this point, there was no need to keep hiding. With his current strength, safeguarding the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was more than easy.

“Your true self is in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?” The first thought in Supreme Xia Qin’s mind was no wonder he hadn’t felt it; the Xuanhuang Secret Realm isolates causal space-time, a fact recognized among the Level Twelve Ultimates.

But then it dawned on Supreme Xia Qin, wasn’t the Xuanhuang Secret Realm already closed?

How did Lin Yuan’s true self get in?

“I have assimilated the Core of the Secret Realm long ago; I am now the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm,” Lin Yuan revealed.

“The master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?”

Supreme Xia Qin felt slightly dazed, followed by a surge of excitement. The Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which dozens of Level Twelve Ultimates have sought after within the universe, had actually fallen into Lin Yuan’s hands?

“You…”

Many thoughts flooded Supreme Xia Qin’s mind, but after examining Lin Yuan again and again, he couldn’t help but say, “You nearly gave me a scare.”
